items.title: Jewel Commercial Group
items.industryZh: 消防与车载安全产品 · 电商
items.roleZh: 电商部新媒体运营实习生
items.summary: Made the short videos that sold Huiyou, the group’s own fire-safety brand, on Douyin, Xiaohongshu and three online stores — scripting, shooting, editing and appearing on camera.
items.summaryZh: 为集团旗下消防安全品牌“汇友”在抖音、小红书和三个电商店铺制作短视频：写脚本、拍摄、剪辑并出镜。

chapters.title: Goal
chapters.text: Make low-interest safety products worth watching, and turn views into store sales.
chapters.textZh: 让低关注度的安全类产品“值得看”，并把播放转化为店铺成交。

chapters.title: Action
chapters.text: Planned a product-and-holiday content calendar, made the videos end to end, and shortlisted 6 creators, closing 2 paid collaborations.
chapters.textZh: 按产品与节日节点排内容日历，独立完成视频全流程；筛选建联 6 位达人，达成 2 位合作。

chapters.title: Result
chapters.text: Followers +15.6%, engagement +11.2%, campaign sales +12%; one account gained 500+ followers in a week.
chapters.textZh: 粉丝 +15.6%，互动率 +11.2%，活动期销售额 +12%；其中一个账号一周涨粉 500+。

chapters.title: Goal
chapters.text: Turn one-off trip participants into people who post, follow and come back.
chapters.textZh: 把一次性参加活动的用户，变成会发内容、会关注、会再来的人。

chapters.title: Action
chapters.text: Built a voucher-based posting incentive, repackaged routes and tags, and ran themed trips with trip-plus-gear bundles.
chapters.textZh: 以代金券设计 UGC 激励，重新包装线路与标签，策划“行程 + 装备”主题活动。

chapters.title: Result
chapters.text: 40+ user posts and 50K+ account reads; a slow route’s sign-ups recovered 35% and themed trips passed 60 sign-ups each.
chapters.textZh: 40+ 篇用户笔记，账号阅读 5 万+；滞销线路报名回升 35%，主题活动单场报名破 60 人。

chapters.title: Action
chapters.text: Ran events such as the Autumn New Owner Night across the app, owner groups and social media, with points-and-badges posting incentives.

chapters.title: Result

chapters.textZh: 192 名新用户，参与率 +10%，200+ 篇 UGC，短视频播放 50 万+。

items.summary: Designed the coupon packages for the Spring Festival charging campaign and measured the results with SQL.

chapters.title: Goal
chapters.text: Get more drivers to charge during the Spring Festival campaign.
chapters.textZh: 春节大促期间，让更多车主完成充电。

chapters.title: Action
chapters.text: Built tiered coupons for new, returning and lapsed drivers, and ran the homepage recommendation strategy.

chapters.textZh: 目标人群转化率提升约 30pp；SQL 复盘报告成为后续活动的参考基线。

items.title: Joy Media
items.summary: Talked to the directors and designers using Small-U, the company’s AI content tool, and turned their needs into product improvements.
items.summaryZh: 对接使用公司 AI 内容工具“小U同学”的编导与设计，把他们的需求转化为产品优化方向。

chapters.title: Goal
chapters.text: Find out what users needed from Small-U, and prove whether changes worked.
chapters.textZh: 弄清用户真正需要小U做什么，并验证优化是否有效。

chapters.title: Action
chapters.text: Collected 150+ needs through surveys and interviews, grouped them into 7 priorities, and tested new features before launch.
chapters.textZh: 通过问卷与访谈收集 150+ 条需求，归纳为 7 个优化点，并在上线前完成功能测试。

chapters.title: Result
chapters.text: Script writing became 30% faster and poster design time dropped 25%.
chapters.textZh: 脚本生成效率提升 30%，海报设计时间缩短 25%。

items.title: InsightLoop
items.role: Built at Joy Media to gather feedback for Small-U, the company’s internal AI content tool. Designed so any product team can use it.
items.roleZh: 在无忧传媒为公司 AI 工具“小U同学”收集反馈时自主开发，任何产品团队都能使用。
items.summary: Turns scattered user feedback into clear product decisions: set up a survey, let AI draft the questions, review them, publish, then read the anonymised results by team and theme.
items.summaryZh: 把分散的用户反馈变成清晰的产品决策：配置调研、AI 生成题目、人工审核、发布，再按团队与主题查看脱敏结果。

media.caption: Survey assistant: set the goal and audience, and AI drafts the questions (interface in Chinese)
media.captionZh: 问卷助手：设定目标与对象，AI 生成候选题目

media.caption: Results dashboard: anonymised answers by team, with recurring themes (interface in Chinese)
media.captionZh: 数据看板：按团队查看脱敏答卷与高频主题

chapters.title: Why
chapters.text: Feedback on Small-U was scattered across chats and documents, so product decisions were slow.
chapters.textZh: 小U的用户反馈分散在聊天和文档里，产品决策很慢。

chapters.title: What I built
chapters.text: I designed and built the whole tool myself: positioning, workflow, interface and dashboard.
chapters.textZh: 我独立完成整个工具：定位、流程、界面与看板。

chapters.title: Next
chapters.text: Link every recommendation back to the feedback behind it, with a human review step.
chapters.textZh: 让每条建议都能追溯到原始反馈，并加入人工复核。

items.sourceNote: The dashboard shows an anonymised sample: 50+ of the 150+ needs collected at Joy Media.
items.sourceNoteZh: 看板为脱敏样本：无忧传媒收集的 150+ 条需求中的 50+ 条。
